t_advice_summary_textbox.text: in summary there are certain gnomes that take you to higher yielding forests and its up to me to find out which ones do that for me

vb_textbox.text: there are only two basket/forest colour schemes. There were 8 gnomes for me and i tried to find out through trial and error which colours, out of the pairs that you get shown, that gave the highest gain of mushrooms. Once i figured this out i stuck only selecting those until i hit either a zero or low numbers for numerous tries. At that point i then switched to the opposite pair which on most occasions was gaining high numbers of mushrooms. I found switching at those points to be very beneficial and did it multiple times after the first break. One gnome will always have the better gain so try to find which colours work best for you. Initially my colour scheme i always selected was pink, red, purple and brown but yours may be different.
